portraits.revision_note: D12.9.6: original male detective, early twenties, warm olive complexion, oblong face, slightly crooked substantial nose, close-set dark hazel eyes, uneven straight brows, short rough black curls brushed sideways with a plain bronze temple clip. A shrewd sideways look and compressed knowing smile. NO spiky cartoon fringe, blue anime eyes or familiar anime head shape. Cropped ink-blue waxed investigator smock with asymmetric bone toggles, cream woven collar, stitched evidence pockets and compact brass measuring caliper. Leaning over a stone workbench, he lines up a cartridge with a scratch in a recovered ceramic panel, making a precise deduction. Low teal inspection lamp, dim industrial evidence room.

Paul Remarque: original broad stocky middle-aged veteran, square-rounded head, freckled pale ruddy skin, broad blunt nose, very short auburn hair at receding temples, clean-shaven full cheeks, pale grey-green eyes, heavy rusty brows. Absolutely distinct from a lean dark-haired pointed-bearded poet. Worn olive field coat with square canvas repairs and plain bone buttons. On a riveted troop carrier bench, shoulders folded inward, one shaking hand grips a creased handkerchief, the other presses the sternum, eyes wet and distant with survivor's guilt. Rose light from rain-streaked window, neutral skin tones, sympathetic sensitive emotional acting. Avoid photographic pores: paint the face with economical large shapes.

Souji: original young adult male cadet with a broad angular jaw, warm beige skin, heavy-lidded dark eyes, flattened nose bridge, slightly uneven grin and a short swept-back ash-brown crop with a narrow naturally silver streak at one temple. NO silver bowl cut, school-uniform jacket, checks or familiar game-character face. Worn forest-charcoal quilted cadet vest over an oatmeal linen shirt, rolled sleeves, asymmetrical clay shoulder guard and practical leather ties. Quietly magnetic, grounded friendly composure. Seated at a crowded barracks mess table, he clasps a rival's forearm in welcome while sliding a shared bread plate to another. Rose lamp over table, ordinary PHC workers and cadets softened behind him. Warmth shown through eye contact and action, not glamour.

Andrade LoveLace, Mother: original elderly female polymath, long broad-browed face, prominent aquiline nose, deep thoughtful brown eyes, mature lines, dark brown hair streaked with silver and arranged in two loose coiled braids tied low behind the head. A few curls escape at the temples, NO historical portrait's sausage ringlets, floral tiara, ribbon bonnet, copied dress. Her elegant but useful dark plum wrap robe has folded cream cuffs, a geometric woven collar, brass calculating beads at the belt, leather folio sling and one scratched magnifying lens on a hinged handle. Old enough to suggest an exceptionally long scholarly life. In a dark archive she compares a small physical relic to an annotated star manuscript; her skeptical eyes suddenly widen with delighted recognition as violet light spills from its cracked display case. Victorian-era intellectual elegance translated into worn PHC scholar equipment, fully original face and silhouette.

The Azure Blood Holder: original adult male aristocratic wanderer, tall lean and dignified, cool pale skin, long rectangular face with a substantial hooked nose, pronounced brow, deep-set grey-blue eyes, a faint healed eyebrow notch and a grave asymmetrical mouth. Dust-blond shoulder-length hair weathered and loosely tied LOW at the nape, two fine braids threaded with small bone rings. NO waist-length platinum mane, vampire face, golden eyes, black-and-gold aristocratic coat, high bat-wing collar, lace cravat, brocade or familiar franchise silhouette. PHC faded slate-blue layered travel mantle, low folded collar, off-white coarse tunic, weathered brown cross-body sword harness, a single worn ivory ceramic forearm guard, oxidized silver fastenings. Noble lineage comes through bearing and precise care for old equipment. Kneeling sideways at a broken shrine stair, one hand lays his plain sheathed sword down behind him while the other supports the wrist of someone being helped upright, face looking toward that person with difficult deliberate mercy. Restrained mulberry shrine lamps and pale daylight give depth without dyeing everything. Plot-important presence, solemn beauty and moral ambiguity. Character design choices are visual proposals, no new supernatural powers.
